title: Friday Night Fanatics | Youth BJJ Tannersville NY
description: Join our Friday youth mat class in Tannersville, NY. Kids practice real moves with friendly partners and kind coaching from Sandy.

Friday Night Fanatics

Friday Night Fanatics is our Friday class for kids and teens. They learn real moves with kind partners. Sandy coaches each round. Class lasts one hour. Your child can learn, move, and have fun.

Real moves. Clear rules. Kind partners.

Sandy guides every round so kids learn and stay safe.

Coached game rounds. Safe partner pairings. Clear skill focus.

Kids try their moves with kind partners. Sandy helps each child learn, take a break, and try again.

See How It Works
Friday is where familiar skills shine.

Kids meet new partners. Sandy helps them stay calm, care for each other, and try smart moves.

HOW WE TRAIN TOGETHER

What a good Friday round looks like
Listen

Hear the rules and the starting spot before each round begins.

Stay Engaged

Try your best move. If it slips, take a breath and try again.

Care for Your Partner

Move with control. Help each other learn and stay safe.

When a partner taps or Sandy calls a pause, let go at once. Then reset.
